spans.s:
नैःश्रेयस (f. ई) & ˚सिक a. giving supreme
bliss.
नैःस्नेह्य n. absence of love, unkindness.

नैःस्व्य^1 n. want of property, poverty.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf. CCS, MW, PW. Also, alph. order.
